title.en: PROVIDING FOR THE ABOLITION OF THE NATIONAL AMNESTY COMMISSION

text.en:
The term of the NAC, created under Proclamation No. 347,
is hereby deemed expired in view of the completion of its assigned tasks as
provided by Section 4 thereof, and the NAC is hereby abolished. The NAC shall
thereby wind-up its operations within sixty (60) days from the issuance of this
Executive Order.
All employees of the NAC shall thereby be entitled to
POMA Hologram • 30055

separation pay in accordance with Executive Order No. 366 (s. 2004) and related
laws, in addition to all other gratuities and benefits that they may be entitled to
under the law.

All assets, liabilities, choses in action, equipment, facilities,
funds, records and other properties of the NAC are hereby transferred to the
Office of the Presidential Adviser on the Peace Process ("OPAPP"). The residual
rights, powers and authority of the NAC, including those provided for under
Proclamation No. 426 (s. 2000), are likewise transferred to the OPAPP. The
OPAPP shall have the power to promulgate the necessary rules and regulations
for the proper implementation of said Proclamation.

This Order shall take effect immediately upon approval.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of March
Our Lord, Two Thousand Five.
in the year of
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
